deployments_detail.use: Oxxo uses AI (loyalty/CRM) to better understand customers and increase product sales

Coca-Cola FEMSA Juntos+ B2B omnichannel platform uses AI to analyze local consumption trends and socioeconomic dynamics to give small merchants ('tienditas') personalized product/purchase recommendations and promotions; 'Juntos+ Advisor' embeds AI into sales-force visits. [Coca-Cola FEMSA (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: 40.4 million digital orders in 2024 (34% of total orders); US$3.1 billion digital sales; ~1.3 million merchants

deployments_detail.use: Coca-Cola FEMSA hyper-personalized retailer engagement: an ML engine generates weekly personalized product recommendations per retailer, and generative AI turns them into customized in-app messages, measured on Amplitude across the Juntos+ base. [Amplitude (analytics) + in-house ML/genAI]
deployments_detail.value: ~100K personalized AI messages weekly; scaled from 2,500-retailer pilot (Dec 2024) to 690,000 retailers; 11% click-through rate (~8 pts higher than non-AI)

deployments_detail.use: OXXO in-store retail media network with AI-driven targeting: two 43-inch screens per store deliver dynamic advertising targeted by location, consumer profile and weather, giving CPG brands point-of-purchase ad placement and OXXO purchase-behavior insights. [Intouch.com (Grupo Salinas)]
deployments_detail.value: Rollout began 2023 across 1,000+ stores; plan to expand to 7,000+ stores

deployments_detail.use: Oxxo Smart cashierless stores operating automatically with AI technology, deployed on university campuses

OXXO Grab & Go autonomous checkout-free store: computer-vision cameras identify customers and products for frictionless purchases via app + QR code. First cashierless store in Latin America (Tec de Monterrey campus), powered by AiFi's spatial-intelligence/computer-vision platform. [AiFi]

OXXO AI/ML-driven demand forecasting and replenishment across its supply chain, including weather-based forecasting to improve product availability and inventory planning. Adopted for both Mexico and international (OXXO LATAM) operations. [RELEX Solutions]

OXXO uses Kuona's AI/machine-learning SaaS to optimize promotions, pricing and product mix from retail data; the OXXO-Kuona collaboration won AMEXCAP's 2023 Alebrije Award (Corporate Venture Capital category) via FEMSA Ventures. [Kuona (Kuona.ai)]

Coca-Cola FEMSA deployed Microsoft 365 Copilot as a daily work assistant and built custom Copilot Studio agents (HR query bots, field-sales advisory agents) across ~90,000 employees to accelerate workflows in legal, HR, communications and field sales. [Microsoft (365 Copilot, Copilot Studio)]
deployments_detail.value: 35% less time on legal analysis; 25% less briefing time; 30% fewer HR tickets; 60-70% less time on repetitive tasks; ~90,000 employees

deployments_detail.use: OXXO adopting Snowflake AI Data Cloud on Microsoft Azure Mexico as its data & analytics foundation for building generative-AI use cases with regional data residency, security and interoperability (quoted by OXXO's Global Data & Analytics Head). [Snowflake + Microsoft Azure]
